create_ion_from_atoms: create an Ion object by passing an ase.Atoms structure directly to the constructor
create_ion_from_db_index: create an Ion object by selecting a specific ion from the database using its index
create_ion_random_from_db: create an Ion object by randomly selecting an ion from the ion database
get_ion_concentration: compute the ion concentration in molarity given a volume in Angstrom cubed
load_ion_fields: load ion fields including atoms, name, and charge from a database dictionary entry
